q: Do a ferrochrome plant's briquetting and pellet plant emissions count?
title: Ferrochrome: briquetting and pelletising
short: Yes, if the briquetting or pelletising unit sits inside your installation. Fuel burnt to dry, preheat or sinter chrome ore fines is a direct emission of the ferrochrome you make, so it belongs in the same CBAM figure.
audience: Odisha ferrochrome producers that agglomerate chrome ore fines on site before smelting

ul: Coal, coke breeze, gas or oil burnt in the pellet induration furnace, sinter strand or dryers.
Process CO2 from any carbonate binder or flux.
Not the electricity for grinding and pressing, which is indirect and not charged for iron and steel goods.

p: If agglomerated ore comes from another company or a separate installation, it is not a CBAM precursor for ferrochrome, and its emissions sit in your Scope 3, not your CBAM figure.
Meter fuel to the agglomeration unit separately from the furnaces. It helps the verifier and shows where a fuel switch would pay.
